sn12.26:1.2: atha kho āyasmā upavāṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.26:2.1: santi pana bhante eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.26:2.2: santi pana bhante eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā parakataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.26:2.3: santi pana bhante eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sayaṃkatañca parakatañca dukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.26:2.4: santi pana bhante eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.26:2.5: idha no bhante bhagavā kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva bhagavato assāma na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn12.26:3.1: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho upavāṇa dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ mayā
sn12.26:3.4: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.26:4.1: tatrūpavāṇa ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.26:4.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.26:5.1: tatrūpavāṇa ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.26:5.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
